name: API Layer
description: Flask blueprints (auth, documents, queries, accounts) that expose icarKno's REST endpoints for document upload, chat/query, speech, and account management, plus the blueprint registration barrel.

name: Service Layer
description: Core business logic services implementing the RAG/search/reasoning pipeline, document and account processing, chat history, authentication, and STT/TTS voice integrations.

name: Controllers Layer
description: Legacy-style request controllers handling SQL/CSV database operations, document summarization, upload chunking, session deletion, and core MongoDB-backed account/session data access, predating the app/api blueprint layer.

name: Data & Search Layer
description: Elasticsearch client, index, document management, and hybrid retrieval modules together with the chat data model classes that define icarKno's persisted and searchable data structures.

name: Utility Layer
description: Cross-cutting helper modules for multi-format text extraction, input security guardrails, and multi-language translation used throughout the services and controllers.

name: Configuration & Bootstrap
description: Flask application factory, extensions/rate-limiting setup, environment-driven configuration classes, server entry point, and environment variable templates that bootstrap the running app.

name: Documentation
description: Project-level README, REST API reference, and detailed backend architecture documentation describing icarKno's design and usage.

name: Dev Tooling & Sample Data
description: Standalone scripts and fixtures used for development and testing: concurrent load-test runner, sample disaster-alert data generator and its generated dataset, and the Understand-Anything analysis tool's own configuration.
